decisions.statement: The counts are what the transcripts say rather than what was kept before.
A day the transcripts say nothing about keeps the counts it already had.
A date no day page is filed under is said rather than kept against no day.
A run that counted no day at all is refused.
A run turns no count into points.
A run writes no value the commit has.
A run that stopped part way is refused naming each day counted before it stopped.
A run that stopped before it counted a day is refused as the fault alone.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.
A call saying any word is refused, because this takes no argument.

definition: the command counting again what Alan wrote each persona on each day
